source_text: Brit Shalom signifies a shift toward secular reinterpretations of Jewish ritual, enabling families to maintain covenantal symbolism—rooted in Genesis 17—without physical alteration, thereby prioritizing bodily autonomy and ethical consent in an era of heightened scrutiny over infant medical procedures.
